actions.reason: The K8_C0006|K8_C0008 boundary is weakly and inconsistently represented: affinity geometry shows material cross-modal disagreement (WXS silhouette 0.400 but CT 0.011, WSI -0.003, RNA -0.030 with RNA inverted), and structural diagnostics show the lowest two-way spectral ARI of the audited pairs (0.506) with moderately high normalized-cut cost (0.635) and a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1). The two units' RNA phenotypes (K8_C0006 low-energy-metabolism/Wnt-high; K8_C0008 proliferation-high/immune-low) are distinct but not so strongly independent as to override the weak, conflicting boundary and merge-compatible union structure. This supports a provisional merge of K8_C0006 and K8_C0008 for re-review rather than preserving the current two-set boundary.

actions.reason: K8_C0001 has a coherent, strongly significant transcriptomic identity (oxidative-phosphorylation-low metabolic phenotype with concordant estrogen-response, adipogenesis, and fatty-acid-metabolism down-regulation). Membership geometry is conflicting (WXS positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the boundary against its nearest neighbors K8_C0004 and K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 is at least partially represented (WXS clear, RNA/WSI weak-to-null), and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology plus a defensible boundary keeps this a valid discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0002 shows a strongly coherent immune-low, oxidative-metabolism-high transcriptomic identity (allograft rejection, IFN-gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3, IFN-alpha, TNFA/NF-kB all down; OXPHOS and fatty-acid metabolism up). Although its own membership silhouettes are non-positive across all four modalities, its boundaries against K8_C0003, K8_C0004, and K8_C0005 are coherently positive across native geometries, and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology and represented boundaries keep this a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0003 has a coherent, strongly significant immune-high inflammatory transcriptomic identity (TNFA/NF-kB, IFN-alpha, allograft rejection, protein secretion, UPR, IL2-STAT5, mTORC1 all up), directionally opposite to K8_C0002. Membership geometry is weak-to-conflicting (CT/WSI weakly positive, RNA/WXS negative), but its boundaries against K8_C0002 and K8_C0005 are coherently positive across native geometries, and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology and represented boundaries keep this a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0004 shows a coherent, strongly significant immune-low, proliferation-low transcriptomic identity (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3, IFN-gamma, IFN-alpha, inflammatory response, EMT, complement, E2F targets all down). Membership geometry is weak-to-conflicting (WSI/CT/RNA weakly positive, WXS negative), but its boundaries against K8_C0001, K8_C0002, and K8_C0007 are coherently positive across native geometries, and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology and represented boundaries keep this a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0005 has a coherent, strongly significant immune-high inflammatory transcriptomic identity (IFN-gamma, allograft rejection, IFN-alpha, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory response, complement all up; ROS up, androgen response down). Membership geometry is weak-to-conflicting (RNA weakly positive, CT null, WSI/WXS negative), but its boundaries against K8_C0002, K8_C0003, and K8_C0007 are coherently positive across native geometries, and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology and represented boundaries keep this a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 has a coherent, strongly significant transcriptomic identity combining OXPHOS-low and immune/interferon-low programs with up-regulated Wnt/beta-catenin and mitotic-spindle signaling. Membership geometry is coherently negative across all four modalities, and its boundaries against K8_C0001 and K8_C0004 are weak-to-conflicting (WXS positive, imaging null). However, this set is the product of a provisional merge that returns to normal review, and no split or further merge is supported; the interpretable biology keeps it a defensible discovery-stage unit pending its own review.

K8_C0007 has a coherent, strongly significant mesenchymal/ECM transcriptomic identity (EMT, UV-response-DN, mitotic spindle, Hedgehog, angiogenesis, apical junction up; OXPHOS and MYC targets V2 down). Membership geometry is conflicting (WXS maximally positive but degenerate, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but its boundaries against K8_C0004 and K8_C0005 are coherently positive across native geometries, and no split or merge is supported. The interpretable biology and represented boundaries keep this a defensible discovery-stage unit.
